title: Did you know… Jesus forgave those who crucified Him while in pain?
paragraphs: Did you know… Jesus forgave those who crucified Him while in pain?
He was suffocating.

Nails through His hands.
Mockery in His ears.
Blood in His eyes.
And still… He spoke.
“Father, forgive them.”

Not after the pain.
Not when it stopped.
While it was happening.
That moment—recorded in Gospel of Luke 23:34—shatters everything we think we know about justice.

Because the ones He was forgiving…
were the ones driving the nails.
Let that sit.

We forgive when it’s over.
Jesus forgave while it was still being done.
But here’s what we miss…
That prayer wasn’t just for them.
It was for us.

Every lie.
Every hidden sin.
Every moment we chose darkness over light—

He saw it all…
and still chose the cross.
This is the Gospel:

You are more sinful than you admit…
but more loved than you can imagine.

And on that cross, mercy didn’t wait for your apology.
Grace moved first.
So what do you do with a Savior like that?

You don’t just admire Him.
You surrender.

Repent.
Turn back.
Receive the forgiveness He already paid for with His blood.

Because the same Jesus who said, “Forgive them”…
is still saying, “Come to Me.”

If this hit your heart, type “Grace.”
no sin is louder than the cross.
